name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $104 after a 7% fall on US–Iran deal hopes; Hormuz still largely shut
state: Brent was near $103.5 on 3 Nov after falling about 7% on 2 Nov to $105 on hopes of a US–Iran deal (CBS), 3% up on the month. The US carried out limited strikes on Iranian targets near Hormuz on 2 Nov and Iran sent a response to US proposals on 3 Nov (AP). Alert holds on the metric floor while the strait remains largely shut.
for_you: Petrol, diesel and heating oil prices remain high; pump prices usually lag crude by a few weeks.
rubric_hit: Brent metric floor = Alert; Hormuz largely shut

sources.title: CBS News — Iran war live updates
AP — US strikes Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
